description: Structural review of a change: changed files (comma-separated, optionally file:start-end) -> changed symbols, blast radius, domains, fan-in-ranked review order. With gate:true it FAILS on new body-confirmed duplication even WITHOUT `before`; add `before` (a prior graph.json) to also fail on new cycles / lost call-callers — the full review gate, agent-reachable.

before.description: Path to the BEFORE graph.json snapshot. For codeweb_diff, "baseline" selects graph.baseline.json beside after; omitted defaults to "prev" (graph.prev.json, written by codeweb_refresh snapshot:true)

changed.description: Comma-separated changed files, each optionally file:start-end (whole file if no range)

gate.description: Fail (isError-style exit) on a structural regression vs `before`

graph.description: Path to graph.json. OPTIONAL — defaults to CODEWEB_WS or the nearest .codeweb/graph.json above cwd

name: codeweb_review
